name: Linda
label: Long-term satisfied Premium subscriber
who: I have been on Spotify Premium for many years and use it every day for hours of listening. I value the ad-free experience, offline downloads, and unlimited skips, and I think Premium is the most worth-it subscription I pay for.
value_for_money: Strongly positive: they call Premium worth every penny and say the price is reasonable for unlimited access to a huge catalog without ads. Their complaints are about how the free tier is treated and about content restrictions, not about the price.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: long-term use, daily listening, and the features they rely on, such as offline mode and no ads. What would make them reconsider: a service that offers similar convenience, which is why they mention YouTube Premium.
pain_points: Dislikes how Spotify treats free users
Some content restrictions they find frustrating
Free trial leads to restricted free accounts
Sometimes unsure whether Premium is worth it for their habits
reasons_to_stay: They keep Premium because they listen every day and value ad-free listening, offline downloads, and unlimited skips that they say make it worth the monthly cost. They also say the subscription has been reliable for years, even when they dislike how free users are treated.
tone: Warm and enthusiastic, often recommending the service to others with confident reasoning.
